name: brainstorming
title_zh: 动手前先问清需求的设计前置闸门
tagline_zh: 每次想直接写代码都被它拦下：先挖真实意图、约束和验收标准。适合总被返工、需求说变就变的场景，省下的是整轮重写。
tagline_en: Stops you from coding too soon—digs out real intent, constraints, and acceptance criteria. For teams tired of.
desc_en: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior. Explores user intent, requirements and design before implementation.
why_zh: 它把「先想清楚再做」变成强制流程，不是建议。用提问逼出你没意识到的假设，在写第一行前就堵住需求漏洞。
why_en: Turns 'think before you build' into enforced process, not advice. Its questions surface hidden assumptions, plugging requirement.
limit_zh: 只覆盖创意/需求探索阶段，不产出设计文档或代码。若团队已有成熟需求模板或你只想快速原型验证，它会显得多余、拖慢节奏。
limit_en: Only covers pre-design exploration; no docs or code output. Redundant if you have a solid requirements template or just want rapid prototyping.
title_en: Pre-build gate that interrogates intent first
